# ADR-020: Keep source contact IDs distinct from Avian contacts and iterative locations

Status: chosen_for_partial_contact_history

Concerns: Q-state, Q-behavior, Q-evidence

## Decision

Generate mCollisions in the existing metadata owner and full logical snapshots. Reset at live/free behavior admission; preserve ordered kernel gradient IDs before angular updates. Project iterative location IDs separately in the existing derived Frame resource.

## Rationale

Source CalculateYawPitchRoll reads mCollisions, while iterative locations are appended only for moved missiles after angle update and partition reinsertion. An actual failing runtime test exposed different yaw/pitch caused by unrelated Avian contact flags.

## Alternatives

Using Avian CollidingEntities, deduplicating IDs, inventing static IDs, or queueing all collision callbacks after full-world publication.

## Consequences

Six direct headless witnesses cover C++ warp bits, 130 sorted original Potential contacts, old/full snapshots, source admission reset/retention and real iterative location identity zero. Missile publication/dispatch continuation, full source locations/history and mandatory proofs remain open.
